title: Plugin-wide modularity governance
purpose: Apply modularization and line-budget rules across the entire Elementor Implementation Toolkit before additional complex feature work expands oversized files.
entry_condition: DEC-EIT-015 is accepted and the current plugin file-size risk is visible.
exit_condition: The plugin has a global line-budget guard, a domain-level module map, and follow-up split tasks for oversized areas.
required_outputs: dependency link into Filter Controller modularization tasks
acceptance_criteria: The line-budget rule covers Admin, CPT, REST, Elementor, Support, assets, scripts, and tests.
Oversized files are classified by domain and split priority.
Future feature work checks destination file size before editing.
Filter Controller modularization uses the global policy instead of becoming a special-case process.
